actors.name: Academic Senate
actors.private_context: The senate is a deliberative body with members who have varying views on pass-fail grading. The motion has been introduced and is on the agenda for the October plenary. The senate's decision will be made by vote at the plenary.

shared_context: Ashvale University's academic senate will hold its October plenary on 2026-10-15 at 10:00 AM. The pass-fail grading motion is on the agenda. The motion was previously discussed in committee and has been reported to the full senate. The senate can pass, reject, or send it back to committee.

starting_events.description: The academic senate's October plenary is scheduled for 2026-10-15. The pass-fail grading motion is on the agenda.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the senate passed the motion at the plenary. Resolve NO if the senate rejected the motion. Resolve SEND_BACK if the senate sent the motion back to committee. If no decision is recorded by the cutoff, resolve NO.
